findings.claim: The new loop-2 Strict Mode block asserts the exact string getByText("Loading services..."). t5 line 29, which scores the loading screen in task 5, accepts the looser regex /Loading services/. A learner whose loading paragraph passes t5, for example 'Loading services…' with a typographic ellipsis or 'Loading services' without dots, then fails t6. The t6 failure is an 'Unable to find an element with the text: Loading services...' error inside the abort test, which reads like an abort-handling problem rather than a wording mismatch carried over from task 5. The TASK 5 comment (OverviewPage.jsx line 16) does give the exact text, so a careful learner can recover, but the two tests disagree about the same screen.
findings.recommendation: Make the two checks agree: either use /Loading services/ in t6 line 45, which is all the abort check needs, or tighten t5 line 29 to the exact 'Loading services...' text so task 5 is where any wording mismatch is reported.
